description: Per-source polling defaults. All times in milliseconds. See docs/live_dashboard_backend/POLLING_PLAN.md for rationale. These are the seed values; the user can override via livedashboard.settings.refreshIntervals.

absences.cost: high (3-page WebForms scrape; MAC-error retries possible)
absences.rationale: IVR data updates within minutes. 15 min surfaces callouts quickly without overrunning the cluster's intermittent failure rate.

compliance.rationale: Due dates change slowly. Hourly is wasteful; 6h captures any meaningful change.

accident.cost: medium (one or two requests per pull)
accident.rationale: Evidence status changes when investigators upload — 30 min keeps the feedback loop tight.

cvp.rationale: Hoops is fast; 15 min is a natural fresh-feeling cadence.

v1.cost: high — Power BI Excel export workflow
v1.rationale: V1 ships import-only. User explicitly drops XLSX. Avoids the failure mode where Power BI session expires silently and stale data goes unnoticed.

v1_5.rationale: Register data updates at end of day/shift. 4 pulls per day plenty.

adaptiveBackoff.v1Note: Not enabled in V1 — re-evaluate after V1.5 ships and we see real failure rates.
